# DmaSync

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Makes cached memory and a device agree before or after a transfer.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_DMASYNC (6)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err DmaSync(Handle dev, uintptr_t bus_addr, size_t len, DmaSyncOp op);
```

**Registers:** `(dev, bus | op, len) -> r0 status`

DMA_SYNC_FOR_DEVICE writes the CPU's cached data back before the device reads; DMA_SYNC_FOR_CPU discards stale cache lines before the CPU reads what the device wrote. Not needed for MEM_UNCACHED memory.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | in | Device handle with PERM_MAP. |
| `bus_addr` | in | Start of the range, inside one of the device's mappings. |
| `len` | in | Length in bytes. |
| `op` | in | DMA_SYNC_FOR_DEVICE or DMA_SYNC_FOR_CPU. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOENT`](../errors.md#err_noent) | The range is not inside a mapping of `dev`. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | Bad range or operation. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `dev` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `dev` is not a device. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `dev` lacks PERM_MAP. |
